CustomField.description: Set to true when a Delivery_Quality_Check__c record linked to this work order has Overall_Pass__c = false (any sod or mulch check failed or was flagged). Set by the Flag Delivery Issue flow in FSL Mobile during Scene 6B. When true: blocks Begin Install button in FSL Mobile until FM decision is recorded, triggers FM push notification, and creates Quality_Case__c. Used on dashboard and work order list views to surface delivery failures without opening individual records.
CustomField.label: Delivery Issue Flag
